m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: A note from my beloved Helgar? I can't wait to read it. Let's see, "your voice rings like..." Okay "...I fretted day upon day..."
Um... wow... he was very... thorough. Hehehe. Could you perhaps summarize it for me?
Oh, he can't talk to me because the pipe is blocked? Well, that probably happened at the Pipe Junction near the Steam Generator. Could you investigate?
Oh, Wizard, the pipe is repaired! I've been listening to my sweet Helgar recite his exhaustive love note aloud in that wonderful voice of his.
It's so much better than reading. Thank you again for all you have done for us.
By which of course I mean YOU must tell her. I can't possibly travel to Inner Athanor. I've heard what they do to Ice Dwarves.
I wrote everything down in this short three-hundred-thirty-page note, with accompanying poems and a few self-portraits.
I worry my note to Morwen wasn't detailed enough. Please deliver it to her!
